title: EN-referent-illumination — structural disjunction (PROPOSED, e6/#55)
status: PROPOSED — e6, REPORT-ONLY. Concludes nothing; no meter, no encoder, no F1, no credential claim. The field owner cuts.
question: does the zh dark-pool STRUCTURAL DISJUNCTION (norms certify the realized light-producing ANCHORS; the latent night-candidates are exactly what norms do not reach) replicate in English with Buchanan-2019 feature-production norms?
rule1_witness: illumination token named in a WordNet NOUN-sense gloss (up to first ';', [a-z]+, Morphy-lemmatized); mirror of the committed EN colour witness noun-gloss rule.
rule1b_realized: lemma is an illumination token OR a noun-sense gloss NAMES it as light/darkness under the naming frame F1(head/genus, first 5 tokens, non-temporal genus) or F2(constitutive 'X of ... TOKEN' / reflect|emit|radiate ... TOKEN); mirror of realized_by_print / the zh G2_realized.
rule2_buchanan: a Buchanan feature row is illumination-class iff its translated root is an ILLUMINATION_TOKEN by lemma (bright/dark STATE class) OR heads a noun.phenomenon/attribute/event synset whose gloss carries a token (light-as-phenomenon / GLOWS class); colour-family roots excluded except 'black'; feature root 'light' flagged ambiguous_light (luminance vs weight, an EN-only polysemy); floor_support = production rate >= 0.20.

refused_synonymy_bleed.note: the figurative senses the broad synonym/derivation expansion would pull and which we REFUSE — the EN mirror of the zh bare-character false friends (光滑/光荣/说明); refusing them keeps the token set faithful to the zh full-pair discipline.

buchanan_reach_limit.note: illumination-ish Buchanan features NOT captured by the pattern (their own WordNet glosses carry none of the 10 tokens) — a declared boundary, mirroring the zh selftest's silent 皎皎/灿烂/辉煌. Reported, not added.

latent_seed_synsets.gloss: the time after sunset and before sunrise while it is dark outside
relative darkness caused by light rays being intercepted by an opaque body

populations.anchors: Buchanan concepts with an illumination feature >= floor (norms reach them)
populations.latent_candidates: WordNet hyponym closure over the seeds, single-word lemmas, MINUS realized members (those are the realized darkness-TERMS, the zh 昏暗 analog)

disjunction_table.zh_prediction: anchors ~ all realized (A>>B); latent candidates ~ all norm-unreached (D>>C)

dark_pole_appearance.reading: ordinary referents Buchanan tags 'dark' = dark-COLOURED / low-light APPEARANCE (coal, coffee, attic), not darkness-TERMS — correctly ¬realized

ambiguous_light_weight.reading: the modal illum feature is bare 'light', which in EN conflates LUMINANCE and WEIGHT (balloon/feather = lightweight); Chinese does not (轻 vs 光)

light_pole_polysemy_or_gloss_gap.reading: a light-pole feature whose light SENSE the classifier caught but the participant likely did not intend (gymnastics 'beam' = balance-beam, actor 'star' = celebrity, shiny objects 'shine'), plus any genuine light-producer WordNet defines without a light token

disjunction_table.verdict: PARTIAL / INSTRUMENT-LIMITED — the LATENT leg replicates cleanly (candidates ~ all norm-unreached), but the ANCHOR leg cannot be cleanly MEASURED in English: Buchanan single-word illumination features are pervasively polysemous/appearance-based (light↔weight, dark↔dark-colour, beam↔balance-beam, star↔celebrity), so 'norm-reached illumination' sweeps in hundreds of non-producer referents — unlike the zh COMPOSITIONAL features 有-光/发光 that pin the sense. The disambiguable CORE (cell A) confirms it: those anchors ARE realized illumination terms.
